baseline: Frozen binaries and libmim.so copied BEFORE experiment edits, using LD_LIBRARY_PATH baseline directory; not a feature toggle in the new library.
build: Release GCC 15.2.1, -O3 -DNDEBUG, same source/dependencies/configuration as frozen baseline; Rust release
verification: Every sample compared against independent Python oracle using full ordered vertex mappings; compiled runner rejects all fallbacks.
backend_scope: Single GraphPattern; conjunction, exact/raw node/literal/capture/type/predicate/use relations. Either/Not/Range and opaque runtime structure use Indexed fallback. No shared multi-pattern automaton.
sanitizer: New backend and differential test TUs instrumented with address,undefined; existing libmim not rebuilt with sanitizers. detect_leaks=0 (LSan blocked by environment); 13 tests pass.
unknown_precision: Earlier type rejection can prove Complete/no-match where the interpreter returns Unknown before deferred type checks; covered by a regression.
